public_brief.objective: Get his man back without starting a brawl he would lose.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The door-side player comes up off his chair like a sack on a hook, boots scrabbling. Up close the fangs are a fitted piece sitting proud of his own teeth, and the white paint has caked in a pale crust at his gumline. The dealer sets his cards face-down.

segments.speaker: Door-side player
segments.text: Ow, ow, mind the teeth, they cost me a week's take! Put me down, I'm nobody, I just sit by the door!

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Gently with the merchandise, friend. A man's smile is his livelihood. You have seen what you came to see; perhaps now you will put him back where you found him.

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: You're holding him off the floor. What now?
